name: task-execution-cadence
body: The cadence for executing one plan task to a durable "done" under the branch graph's content-identity staleness guard: one task per implementer session; the implementer commits its work and returns; the coordinator quick-verifies the commit against the task's target, scans so the recorded HEAD catches up, then resumes the session to mark done (`apg_plan_done`) and note (`apg_plan_note`). The guard admits every plan/review mutation when the recorded HEAD matches the working tree (same sha and clean), so the cadence orders commit before marking done and keeps the tree clean at the mark; "mark done then commit" and "mark done while dirty" fall outside the guard. Target-less tasks (spikes, gates, file-level aggregates) that write nothing and leave the tree clean reach completion through their stated condition, and those tasks are ordered after the units they aggregate, with gate tasks last. This entity is the ordering discipline for mutating the plan; it is distinct from `domain.entity.graph-first-navigation`, the ordering discipline for querying the graph.
